notes: S2-FIX3 F75 (decision 2026-11-16 #1; §11.1, §11.9, §14.5): container/readable-root-regular-file-zip with one byte of a record member's stored data flipped. The zip phases 1-4 and the entry checks pass; the root regular file named readable is outside the layout (E_CONTAINER_ENTRY) and the record member then fails its CRC-32 as it is read (E_CONTAINER_ZIP). Both are independent violations of container step (1), and the failing stage reports every violation it finds: both codes. No readable/ entry exists, so no N_READABLE_PRESENT.
